title: Theragun PRO 5th Gen, Black (Factory Reconditioned)

comparisons.notes: Theragun PRO (5th Gen) by Therabody, new condition, in stock at $529.99. Woot's unit is factory reconditioned.
Therabody Theragun Pro 5th Gen, new condition, in stock at $549. Woot's unit is factory reconditioned.

writeup: Woot has a factory reconditioned Theragun PRO 5th Gen in black for $189.99. It's Therabody's pro-grade massage gun with a 16mm amplitude, five speeds from 1750 to 2400 percussions per minute, a 150-minute battery and six attachments. New units are $529.99 at Pharmalynk and $549 at Rivete, and Woot limits it to 3 per customer.
